High level impact and recommendation:

- Feasibility: Yes - we can run both workloads in the same PoC. Suggest two model endpoints:
  1) Summarization endpoint (medium LLM, kv-cache optimized) for thread summarization
  2) Classification endpoint (smaller, faster encoder or distilled model) for intent classification

- Infra impact: modest. We'll need one additional small GPU instance for the classification endpoint to meet the 200ms p95 requirement under light concurrency. That adds ~1 week of provisioning and testing.

- Evaluation/engineering: Dev will need ~3 days to add the classification evaluation harness and data ingestion hooks. We'll need their labeled samples (CSV) and mapping table for intents.

- Cost: Estimated incremental trial cost ~$4k (GPU run + extra infra + 1-week extension). I attached a quick poc_cost_estimate.pdf.

Recommended re-baseline:
- PoC duration: 4 weeks (kickoff 11/29, wrap 12/27, two evaluation weeks + buffer)
- Success criteria: keep summarization targets as-is; add classification: precision >= 0.82 top-3, latency p95 < 200ms
- Owners: Marissa (engagement), Rishi (infra), Dev (evaluation harness), Alex (Acme data/labels)

If that looks good I'll queue the infra and create the extra endpoint.

-Rishi
